summary: Lists connected serial devices and can poll or callback when devices are added, removed, occupied, or become available.

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Runs once for each change to the device table

key_params.name: usage
key_params.note: Report any, in-use, or not-in-use serial devices

key_params.name: enablepolling
key_params.note: Poll periodically for serial device changes

key_params.name: pollingtime
key_params.note: Interval between polls when polling is enabled

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Serial Devices DAT discovers ports; it does not open or communicate with devices by itself.
Usage filtering can hide occupied or available devices depending on the selected mode.
Polling too frequently can add avoidable OS/device-manager churn in large hardware setups.
Callbacks should treat device rows as volatile because USB serial devices can disappear or rename across reconnects.
key_concepts: Lists serial devices available to TouchDesigner.
Usage controls which serial-device category is listed.
Refresh Pulse updates the detected device table on demand.
Polling controls periodically refresh the list and set the polling interval.
